Abstract:

The 10th World Circular Economy Forum (WCEF 2026 was held on 15-16 September 2026 at Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The forum brought together policymakers, researchers, industry representatives, entrepreneurs and sustainability professionals to discuss pathways for moving from a linear "take- make-dispose" model towards a circular economy. Its focus included resource efficiency, waste prevention, sustainable production and consumption, innovation, policy support and inclusive prosperity. I participated as a nominated delegate from the National Institute of Technology, Rourkela, gaining exposure to circular economy strategies and their application to environmental challenges.
